name: cyber-editor
description: Cyber Editor desktop platform for template-driven AI orchestration and structured artifact handoff.
author: OpenAI Codex

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:catalog-integrity: node scripts/run-vitest-with-report.mjs --name catalog-integrity -- run tests/unit/playwright-spec-selection.test.ts tests/unit/full-test-decomposition-coverage.test.ts tests/unit/executable-test-catalog-coverage.test.ts tests/unit/quality-gate-coverage.test.ts tests/unit/ui-contract-registry.test.ts tests/unit/delivery-quality-gate.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs playwright test
scripts.test:ui:shell: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/prototype-shell-alignment.spec.ts
scripts.test:ui:pages: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs node scripts/ui-page-validation.mjs
scripts.test:ui:contracts: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/ui-prototype-contracts.spec.ts tests/e2e/ui-design-contracts.spec.ts tests/e2e/ui-action-contracts.spec.ts tests/e2e/ui-state-contracts.spec.ts tests/e2e/ui-latency-contracts.spec.ts tests/e2e/ui-manipulation-contracts.spec.ts tests/e2e/thinking-map-contracts.spec.ts
scripts.test:ui:orchestration: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/critical-editor-workflows.spec.ts
scripts.test:post-change-extreme: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs node scripts/run-post-change-extreme-validation.mjs
scripts.sync:experience-rules: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs node scripts/sync-experience-rules.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:packaged-smoke: set CYBER_EDITOR_RUN_PACKAGED_SMOKE=1&& node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/packaged-smoke.spec.ts
scripts.test:packaged-ui-contracts: set CYBER_EDITOR_RUN_PACKAGED_UI_CONTRACTS=1&& node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs playwright test tests/e2e/packaged-ui-contracts.spec.ts tests/e2e/packaged-workbench-ui-fixes.spec.ts
scripts.test:user-self: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs node scripts/run-p018-user-self-test.mjs
scripts.demo:closed-loop: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs node scripts/run-closed-loop-demo.mjs
scripts.demo:closed-loop:regression: npm run build && node scripts/with-clean-electron-env.mjs node scripts/run-closed-loop-regression.mjs
scripts.demo:packaged-closed-loop:regression: npm run package && npm run test:packaged-closed-loop
